newsitem.title: USA: TVA issues $200 mln two-year debt at +16bp.
newsitem.headline: TVA issues $200 mln two-year debt at +16bp.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority on Wednesday said it issued $200 million in two-year power bonds in an offering aimed specifically at investors in the western United States.
It was the second such regional offering by TVA. TVA's first regional bond sale in 1995 targeted investors in the Tennessee Valley region.
BancAmerica Securities Inc was the lead manager. Proceeds from the sale will be used to refinance TVA's short-term debt.
